sentences.text:
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjay Kumar Srivastava,Shiva Kant Srivastava

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Mithal,J.
Hon'ble Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel.
The petitioner has preferred this petition so as to challenge the order dated 30.04.2019 passed by respondent no.2 imposing penalties under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The aforesaid order is appealable under the provision of the said Act.
Therefore, in view of the said alternative remedy, we do not deem it proper to exercise our discretionary jurisdiction.
The writ petition is dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to avail the statutory remedy of appeal.
